records.normalizedEnglish: Atkinson attributes influence and leadership to strength of directed will and awareness of the self, illustrating this with Napoleon. These are author assertions and anecdotes, not controlled evidence or a practice protocol.

Choose a goal and work toward it, removing obstacles; the author says a definite desire and knowledge of oneself are needed to realize plans. No numbered exercise, assessment threshold, duration or repetition schedule appears here.
records.originalRussian: Намѣтьте себѣ цѣль и прямо стремитесь къ ней, удаляя съ своего пути всѣ препятствія.

records.normalizedEnglish: The author defines directed will as a conscious manifestation of will producing thought vibrations aimed at an object, distinguishes conversation from distant transmission called telepathy, and cites alleged private practitioners. The narrative continues on page65; it is not an independently verified result.
